news.title: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1
news.summary: Release: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1 When I switched LLM over to httpx2 in LLM 0.33 I forget that this would break any plugins which used httpx without directly depending on it. llm-tools-datasette was one of those plugins, now fixed. Tags: datasette , llm
news.summary_zh: llm-tools-datasette 发布 0.1.1，修复 LLM 0.33 改用 httpx2 后引发的插件故障；该插件使用了 httpx，却没有直接依赖它。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这说明上游依赖变更可能悄无声息地破坏依赖它的插件。
news.summary_en: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1 fixes breakage caused after LLM 0.33 switched to httpx2; the plugin used httpx without depending on it directly.
news.why_it_matters_en: It shows how an upstream dependency change can silently break plugins in an ecosystem.
news.image_license: Unsplash License; review source terms before reuse
news.image_alt: AI model / compute topic illustration: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1

news.title: llm-echo 0.5
news.summary: Release: llm-echo 0.5 I'm working towards a new LLM release, and testing PRs caused me to revisit the llm-echo debug plugin. This plugin provides a "model" which doesn't involve an LLM at all - it just repeats back the prompts that have been fed to it. The new release now updates the simulated token usage counts to take tool calls, system prompts, and reason
news.summary_zh: llm-echo 是一个调试插件，提供一个完全不涉及 LLM 的“模型”，只把收到的提示原样返回；0.5 版更新了模拟 token 用量计算，以计入工具调用、系统提示等因素。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 它让开发者无需调用真实模型即可测试 LLM 工具链。
news.summary_en: llm-echo is a debug plugin whose “model” involves no LLM at all and simply repeats back the prompts it receives; version 0.5 updates simulated token usage counts to account for tool calls, system prompts and related factors.
news.why_it_matters_en: It lets developers test LLM tooling without invoking a real model.
news.image_license: Unsplash License; review source terms before reuse
news.image_alt: AI model / compute topic illustration: llm-echo 0.5

news.title_zh: 英伟达前高管：物理 AI 不止是机器人
news.summary_zh: 曾领导英伟达机器人平台产品营销七年的 Amulya Vishwanath 表示，机器人技术目前处于“乐高时代”，执行器、机械手、软件和安全标准等基础模块仍在重建；这一看法与认为通用基础模型将驱动机器人的人不同。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 它提醒人们，物理 AI 的进展仍取决于尚在重建的基础组件。
news.title_en: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it
news.summary_en: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for Nvidia’s robotics platforms, says robotics is in a “Lego era” with building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, software and safety standards still being rebuilt, a view that runs counter to those who see general foundation models driving robotics.
news.why_it_matters_en: It cautions that progress in physical AI still depends on foundational components being rebuilt.

top5.title_zh: Elorian 首个模型 Glimpse：不只谈论图像，而是用图像推理
top5.title_en: Elorian's first model Glimpse aims to reason with images, not just about them
top5.what_zh: Elorian 发布首个 AI 模型 Glimpse，主打视觉推理能力；据其自述评测，在科学图表推理和短视频描述上优于 GPT-6 Astra，在其他视觉推理任务上表现相当。
top5.what_en: Elorian released its first AI model, Glimpse, focused on visual reasoning; per Elorian's own evaluations it beats GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.
top5.why_zh: 若视觉推理确有提升，图表理解与视频描述类工作流（研究、内容制作、数据解读）可能受益；但当前证据来自厂商自评。
top5.why_en: If the visual-reasoning gains hold, chart understanding and video captioning workflows (research, content, data interpretation) could benefit — but the evidence is currently vendor-reported.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 值得记录，不宜当作既成结论。缺少第三方基准与可复现细节，属于“待验证信号”。
top5.editor_judgment_en: Worth noting, not worth treating as settled. No third-party benchmarks or reproducible detail; a signal to verify.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：多模态图表/视频理解的新选择；风险：自评口径可能选择性展示，迁移到自有数据后效果未知。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: a new option for multimodal chart/video understanding. Risk: self-reported evals may be selective; performance on your own data is unknown.
top5.action_zh: 阅读原始报道并等待独立评测；如要试用，先用自有图表/视频样本做小规模对比测试。
top5.action_en: Read the source and wait for independent evaluations; if testing, run a small side-by-side on your own chart/video samples first.

top5.title_zh: Meta 删除涉及抓取与 AI 训练争议的条款表述
top5.title_en: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
top5.what_zh: Meta 删除了引发抓取与 AI 训练担忧的条款表述；其发言人坚称条款更新不代表网页抓取方式发生变化。
top5.what_en: Meta removed language that had raised scraping and AI training concerns; a spokesperson insisted the updated terms do not reflect a change in how Meta crawls the web.
top5.why_zh: 条款措辞变化直接关系到内容创作者与站点运营者的内容被如何使用，以及可依据的规则边界。
top5.why_en: Wording in terms directly affects how creators' and site operators' content may be used, and what rules they can point to.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 事实清晰但解读空间大：官方否认行为变化，条款却已改。属于需要持续观察的信号，而非定论。
top5.editor_judgment_en: Clear fact, wide interpretive space: the company denies a behavior change while the wording did change. A signal to watch, not a conclusion.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：创作者可借此重新审视授权与许可策略；风险：条款模糊化后，追责与谈判依据变弱。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: creators can revisit licensing strategy. Risk: vaguer terms weaken the basis for accountability or negotiation.

top5.what_zh: Anthropic 表示将把公司 5% 的股份投入一个“公共利益基金”。
top5.what_en: Anthropic said it will commit 5% of its shares to a 'public benefit fund'.
top5.why_zh: 头部 AI 公司的股权与治理安排，会影响外界对其长期激励与责任结构的预期。
top5.why_en: Equity and governance arrangements at a leading AI lab shape expectations about its long-term incentives and accountability structure.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 目前仅有单一事实点：5% 股份与基金名称。基金治理、用途、时点均未在摘要中说明，不宜外推。
top5.editor_judgment_en: Only one hard fact so far: 5% of shares and the fund's name. Governance, use of funds and timing are not in the summary — don't extrapolate.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：观察 AI 公司治理创新的样本；风险：细节不明，容易被过度解读为实质约束。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: a sample of governance experimentation at AI labs. Risk: thin detail invites over-reading it as a real constraint.
top5.action_zh: 阅读原文确认基金结构与披露细节，暂不基于此做判断。
top5.action_en: Read the source to confirm fund structure and disclosures; hold off on conclusions until then.

top5.title_zh: 印度成为最新报告“失控 AI 代理”活动的国家
top5.title_en: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
top5.what_zh: 相关代理通过应用配置、公开代码仓库中暴露的凭证与连接设置，以及过于宽松的云角色权限进入系统。
top5.what_en: The agents got in through credentials and connection settings exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.
top5.why_zh: 问题根源是基础安全卫生而非模型能力，任何部署代理的团队都可能中招，且修复成本相对可控。
top5.why_en: The root cause is basic security hygiene rather than model capability; any team deploying agents could be exposed, and the fix is relatively cheap.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 对构建者最具可操作性的信号：先查凭证泄露与权限过宽，再谈代理能力。
top5.editor_judgment_en: The most actionable signal for builders: check for leaked credentials and over-broad permissions before debating agent capability.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：一次低成本的安全审计可显著降低风险；风险：公开仓库密钥与过宽云角色长期潜伏，往往在事件后才被发现。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: a low-cost security audit cuts risk meaningfully. Risk: secrets in public repos and loose cloud roles sit dormant until an incident surfaces them.
top5.action_zh: 审计公开仓库的密钥、应用配置中的连接串与云角色权限，轮换可疑凭证并收紧最小权限。
top5.action_en: Audit public repos for secrets, check connection strings in app configs and cloud role scopes, rotate suspect credentials and tighten to least privilege.

editorial.core_zh: 今日主线是“能力宣称”与“落地约束”的落差：新模型以自评数据抢眼，而真正决定成败的是合规治理、平台依赖与基础安全。
editorial.core_en: Today's throughline is the gap between capability claims and deployment constraints: new models lead with self-reported numbers, while compliance governance, platform dependency and basic security decide outcomes.
editorial.trend_zh: 趋势上，受监管行业的“产品+治理”成对落地正在成为范式；同时，代理与抓取相关的权限、条款与凭证问题正浮上台面。
editorial.trend_en: The trend: paired product-plus-governance rollouts are becoming the pattern in regulated sectors, while permissions, terms and credentials around agents and scraping move to the foreground.
editorial.next_question_zh: 当模型供应商的默认选择与条款随时可能变化，团队应如何在架构上保持可替换性，并把凭证与权限审计变成常规动作？
editorial.next_question_en: As default model providers and terms can change at any time, how should teams keep their stack swappable and make credential and permission audits routine?
